pages.name: Polovyk
pages.text: A man in clothes covered with daisies. Hovers above the ground in the centre of the Plains.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: Never attacks first. Strike him and he becomes $(#A33B3B)very fast and strong$(): he catches even a Spirit in the air, and his blows hurt you in Spirit form. No effects.$(br2)The centre of the biome, where he stands, is marked by the narrowest rings of $(l:plains/poludnytsia)Poludnytsia$(/l).

pages.title: Gifts
pages.text: Give him any flower and he stops attacking.$(br2)If it is a $(item)Poludnytsia$(), he repays you:$(li)1st: enchanted golden apple;$(li)2nd and 3rd: golden apple;$(li)4th and 5th: plain apple;$(li)after that: nothing, and he will not take the flower.$(br2)The count is separate for each player.
